summary: Social media service marketplace website (Arabic): sell followers, likes, and views for social media platforms with admin dashboard for pricing management and customer order system
architectural_notes: Arabic RTL website for social media services marketplace
Services include: followers, likes, views for social platforms

existing_features.title: Create a homepage in Arabic (RTL layout) with branding for IBAZEX social media services marketplace, showcasing the value proposition of selling followers, likes, and views for social media platforms
Create an admin dashboard with authentication that allows editing service prices, adding new services, and managing service availability
Implement customer order system allowing users to place orders for services with fields for customer details (name, contact), selected service, quantity, and any additional information
Integrate Internet Identity authentication system for secure user and admin access

new_feature_requests.summary: Services page with pricing table for social media services (followers, likes, views)
Admin dashboard to edit services and pricing

Build a services page displaying available social media services (followers, likes, views) for different platforms (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) in a simple table format with service name, price, and description columns

Implement backend data model and API endpoints for services with fields including platform (Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), service type (followers/likes/views), price, description, and availability status

Apply a creative, modern, and professional visual design theme with a distinct style that reflects the digital marketing and social media industry, using a cohesive color palette, typography, and layout patterns consistently throughout the application
